description: Enhanced, native-disjoint cases for unindenting CRLF text. Adds coverage the native suite lacks: a content first line that keeps its CR and indentation, a trailing CRLF break, deeper nesting preserved across CRLF lines, an interior CRLF blank line whose lone CR counts as content and pins the common indent to 0, a plain two-line space-indented CRLF block, and a spaces+CR 'blank' line that is treated as content and unindented.
